details:
StarStream is an interactive web-based decision-support map built to empower farmers and agricultural researchers with real-time NASA Earth observation data. By transforming complex satellite datasets into intuitive, visual map layers, the platform allows users to monitor environmental shifts and evaluate crop conditions effortlessly.

To address the challenges of unpredictable climate patterns and resource management, StarStream features a custom area selection tool. Farmers can draw boundaries directly over their specific fields to run targeted spatial analyses, receiving localized environmental metrics rather than generalized regional forecasts.

This precision approach is critical for modern sustainable agriculture. By bridging the gap between open-access space data and everyday farming decisions, StarStream helps growers optimize irrigation, detect early signs of environmental stress, and improve overall crop yields while minimizing ecological impact.
